_source: GENERATED by extract_constants.py from REG-002 Section 4's protected-write authorization sentence (PROTECT_KEY1/2, PROTECT_TIMEOUT_CYCLES), ARCH-002's ARCH-CLK-001 row (CORE_CLK_HZ), and ARCH-002 SS12.1's shared-buffer segment table (DFC_BUF_CLIENTn_BASE/_WIDTH, DFC_BUF_CLIENT_COUNT, DFC_BUF_TOTAL_WORDS). The protected-write values are matched via a deliberately narrow prose pattern (see this file's own header) since they are protocol constants stated in running text, not register table fields.
